technology_name: Bendable Piezoelectric Touch Sensor for Flexible Electronics
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Rigid semiconductor touch arrays leak significant current, are prone to mechanical shattering, and cannot adapt smoothly to non-planar or flexible robotic skin structures.
description: A bendable piezoelectric touch sensor architecture comprising a buried oxide layer, a metal oxide semiconductor field effect transistor (MOSFET), and a sol-gel processed piezoelectric sensing element built directly over an ultra-thin flexible silicon diaphragm.
applications: Advanced robotic tactile skins, smart prosthetic limb feedback interfaces, industrial automation grip sensors, and flexible consumer electronic control pads.
secondary_sector: MedTech & Health Care, Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
